body: I notice the soft glow of the light, warm and comforting, like a mother's gentle touch. My thoughts swirl with the desire to shield them from the harsh realities of the world outside. I reach out a hesitant hand, hesitantly, and gently place it beside them. My fingers intertwine with theirs, a subtle yet powerful gesture of reassurance and protection. Together, we stand, steadfast and steady, ready to face whatever may come.
